records.domainArgument: The shear K is positive and greater than2. Gram determinant1 and trace2+K²t² give the larger singular value. Its logarithmic derivative decreases from K/2−1>0 to−1, giving the unique global maximum at sqrt(K²−4)/K. A corresponding unit eigenvector attains it.

optionsVisibleBounds.derivation: At t=1 use the unit vector e2 to obtain sqrt(1+K²)/e. The triangle inequality gives ||I+KtN||≤1+Kt, whose exponentially damped maximum is K*exp(−1+1/K).
